en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, raising it who said,
‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Had it not been that the plotting and the deception would be in the Fire, Iasws would have been the most skilful in evil planning’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim in a marfu’ manner who has said the following:
“Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) has said, ‘Had evil planning and deceit not been in the fire, I would have been extremely skillful in evil planning.’”
